    • reserve

      public PaymentExecutionStatusChanged reserve(ReservePaymentFundsCommand command)
      Reserves source funds and required Lightning capacity, then transitions the execution to LOCKED. All effects must participate in the caller's submission transaction.
      Parameters:
      command - identifies the account and execution to reserve
      Returns:
      confirmed transition event for QUORUM_SYNC to LOCKED
